model: generalized heat conduction: generalized Cattaneo-Vernotte and Green-Naghdi models
method: Laplace transform, numerical inverse Laplace transform

model: fractional Cattaneo-Vernotte and fractional Green-Naghdi thermoelastic models
finding: Fractional CV and FGN models predict anomalous thermoelastic responses: higher temperature and compressive stress than classical thermoelasticity; FGN type-I model predicts anomalous responses for all time range.

geometry_class: not specified on page 1 (homogeneous regular anisotropic piezoelectric material)
model: temperature rate dependent two temperature (TRDTT) piezothermoelasticity
finding: Derives variational principle of convolution type and reciprocity theorem for TRDTT piezothermoelasticity; alternative formulation incorporates initial conditions into field equations.

geometry_class: infinite non-homogeneous orthotropic functionally graded medium with spherical cavity
model: three-phase-lag thermoelastic heat conduction with higher-order time-fractional derivatives
method: Taylor series expansion of time-fractional order
finding: New higher-order fractional TPL thermoelastic model extending Ezzat and Roychoudhuri models; includes high-order time-fractional derivatives of TPLs in heat flux, temperature gradient and thermal displacement gradient; applied to FGM medium with spherical cavity.

model: dual-phase-lag heat conduction: two competing hyperbolic models
method: mathematical analysis, comparison of parameter regions
finding: Compares two DPL heat conduction models; shows stability parameter regions differ between models; real material data fall in range where both agree or both disagree.

model: nonlocal piezothermoelasticity with dual-phase-lag, two-temperature, MDD
finding: Primary P waves strike interface; one reflected wave in fluid half-space and four transmitted waves in piezothermoelastic medium; energy ratios affected by nonlocal, DPL, two-temperature and MDD parameters; energy conservation verified across interface.
